status_rule: After completing a task, set its check field to true. In future runs, only tasks with check false are eligible for work.
scope: Regenerate all ZBLL SVG images from VisualCube while keeping existing non-ZBLL algsets, unrelated docs, and source spreadsheet files untouched.
assumptions: Use VisualCube case= with the first algorithm in each ZBLL case.
Use fmt=svg, size=150, pzl=3, stage=ll, view=plan.
Keep existing ZBLL recognition colors: T purple, U yellow, L orange, H green, Pi red, Sune black, Antisune gray.
Do not modify unrelated untracked docs or source spreadsheets.

tasks.title: Confirm current ZBLL baseline
tasks.summary: Confirm ZBLL currently has 40 groups, 472 cases, 472 SVGs, and passes JSON validation.

tasks.title: Create VisualCube regeneration script
tasks.summary: Add a resumable script that fetches VisualCube SVGs into source/cache/visualcube-zbll and writes svgs.json only when all cases succeed.
verify: Run python py_compile for the script.
Review URL parameter construction and algorithm normalization.

tasks.title: Commit script and checklist
allowed_fields: git index for script and checklist
tasks.summary: Create a first commit containing only the regeneration script and checklist.
verify: Confirm unrelated docs and spreadsheet are not staged.

tasks.title: Regenerate ZBLL SVGs
tasks.summary: Fetch all 472 VisualCube SVGs and replace ZBLL svgs.json only if there are no failures.
verify: Confirm failures.json is empty or absent.
Confirm svgs.json has exactly 472 keys matching case IDs.

tasks.title: Rebuild app bundle and bump cache
protected_fields: app behavior outside data bundle and cache version
tasks.summary: Regenerate app/js/data.js and bump app/sw.js cache version by one.
verify: Confirm service worker cache version increased.

tasks.title: Validate generated outputs
tasks.summary: Run JSON and JavaScript checks, then inspect representative cases from each recognition.
verify: Run node --check for app/js/data.js, app/js/render.js, app/sw.js.
Inspect one case for each of T, U, L, H, Pi, Sune, Antisune.

tasks.title: Commit generated outputs
tasks.targets: ZBLL source JSON, app bundle, style/render/cache changes
tasks.summary: Create a second commit with regenerated ZBLL app data and related app integration files only.
verify: Confirm unrelated docs and spreadsheet are not staged.

tasks.title: Push after user approval
tasks.summary: Request approval before pushing commits to GitHub.
verify: Push only after explicit user approval.
